_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Manual Validation Plan
summary: Sets forth the schedule for contractor validation of instructions and procedures in technical manuals relating to installation, operation, assembly, disassembly, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
use_relationship:
The Technical Manual Validation Plan sets forth the schedule for contractor validation of instructions and procedures in technical manuals relating to installation, operation, assembly, disassembly, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data generated under the work task described in the contract and Appendix C of NSA DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Document
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals, current edition, is available at the National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6718; Attn: I5222.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Technical Manual Validation Plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor shall provide a plan for each technical manual in accordance with Appendix C of NSA DS-56.
